name: Convertible JPY Token
oneLiner: CJPY is Yamato's decentralized Japanese yen stablecoin, minted from overcollateralized ETH pledges via Liquity-v1-style permissionless CDPs.
collateral: ETH only; 130% minimum collateralization ratio at issuance (110% MCR for liquidation); one-time borrowing fee with no accrued interest
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized ETH CDPs (pledges) with game-theory peg maintenance: (1) hard floor via on-chain redemption of 1 CJPY for 1 JPY worth of ETH from the riskiest pledge; (2) subrogation mechanism uses accumulated protocol fees to automatically repay positions below 100% health rate; (3) non-forced liquidation where any user can redeem debt positions below 130% using market-purchased CJPY

oracleRisk.summary: Yamato's sole ETH pledge branch derives ETH/JPY from Chainlink ETH/USD and JPY/USD feeds and reverts when either component is broken or stale; there is no alternate provider fallback in the live PriceFeedV3 path.

branchApplicability.rationale: The live Yamato deployment exposes one ETH-backed CJPY pledge market. Its composite oracle, 130% minimum collateral ratio, permissionless redemption path, reserve-funded residual-debt sweep, and pause behavior form one collateral-liquidation branch.

branches.label: Yamato ETH pledges
branches.summary: The sole CJPY debt branch prices ETH in JPY from two Chainlink components and permits under-MCR pledge redemption, with zero-collateral residual debt routed to the Sweep Reserve process.

feeds.path: Chainlink ETH/USD divided by Chainlink JPY/USD -> Yamato PriceFeedV3 -> ETH pledge collateral ratio

branches.fallbackBehavior: PriceFeedV3 rejects non-positive, malformed, future-dated, or unavailable Chainlink responses. It reverts when ETH/USD is older than one hour or JPY/USD is older than 24 hours; the deployed V3 path has no alternate-provider fallback.

collateralParameters.note: The live Yamato proxy returned MCR = 130 at Ethereum block 25530969. CJPY debt is backed only by native ETH pledges.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Any caller holding CJPY can invoke Yamato's redemption path against the lowest-collateralized pledges below the 130% MCR. The contracts contain no time-based waiting gate before an eligible pledge can be redeemed.
branches.backstop: Redemption burns the caller's CJPY against pledge debt and transfers the corresponding ETH. If a pledge reaches zero collateral with debt remaining, the permissionless sweep process repays that debt from the protocol Sweep Reserve, subject to available reserve balance.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Broken or stale Chainlink input makes PriceFeedV3 revert rather than use an alternate feed. Yamato's pause guard stops user actions when governance pauses the protocol; zero-collateral residual debt remains queued for reserve-funded sweeping and cannot be swept when the Sweep Reserve is empty.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: No direct CJPY blacklist or transfer freeze was confirmed, but Yamato's CurrencyOS/Yamato routing is governance-settable and includes protocol burn and pause paths. Treat as possible mutable holder-facing protocol control.

mintAuthority.summary: CJPY is minted permissionlessly from Yamato's Liquity-v1-style ETH pledges (130% MCR, one-time fee, no interest). The Yamato contract is a UUPS proxy (ERC1967Proxy) pointing to YamatoV4 implementation; upgrade authority (onlyGovernance) is held by a 2-of-4 Gnosis Safe at 0x0b0a167a0b6800207c89544d2ebdc98dcdd33bec with no modules. CJPY token is non-upgradeable with no owner.

controls.label: Yamato pledge contract (ETH CDP mint)
controls.capDescription: Mint bounded by the 130% minimum collateralization ratio on ETH pledges, with redemption-based peg defense.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295201, the Yamato proxy (0x02Fe72b2E9fF717EbF3049333B184E9Cd984f257) has EIP-1967 impl slot pointing to YamatoV4 (0x0bfa59f9fbe9565c240cd64311c86e90e59a4838, 29684 bytes); proxy admin slot = 0x0 (UUPS pattern). Users mint CJPY by overcollateralizing ETH at 130% MCR.

controls.label: Yamato governance Safe (upgrade + parameter authority)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295201, governance() on the Yamato proxy returns 0x0b0a167a0b6800207c89544d2ebdc98dcdd33bec (GnosisSafeProxy); getOwners() = 4 addresses; getThreshold() = 2; getModulesPaginated returns empty array (next=sentinel, length=0). YamatoV4 source confirms onlyGovernance modifier gates upgrades and parameter changes.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295201: Yamato proxy (0x02Fe72b2E9fF717EbF3049333B184E9Cd984f257) is an ERC1967Proxy (UUPS) pointing to YamatoV4 impl (0x0bfa59f9fbe9565c240cd64311c86e90e59a4838); proxy admin EIP-1967 slot = 0x0 (UUPS). governance() returns 0x0b0a167a0b6800207c89544d2ebdc98dcdd33bec (GnosisSafeProxy, 4 owners, threshold 2, no modules). CJPY token (0x1cfa5641c01406ab8ac350ded7d735ec41298372): EIP-1967 proxy admin slot = 0x0, owner() reverts — immutable non-upgradeable token.

reserveReview.reviewer: SONG Safety Score V9 reserve review
reserveReview.rationale: Yamato documents CJPY as minted against ETH pledges with a 130% minimum collateral ratio. The tracked reserve envelope is therefore the sole ETH collateral category; live position weights change onchain and are not represented as a static allocation.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No reserve exposure outside ETH pledges is documented; current individual pledge positions are dynamic.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Native ETH collateral is an external asset rather than a tracked stablecoin dependency.
